forbidden.name: no-module-service-internal-cross-import
forbidden.comment: A module or service may only be imported by another module or service through its public entry point (src/index.ts). Reach into another module's or service's internals directly, and this rule fires. Shared packages/* stay unrestricted since they are the intended neutral integration point.

forbidden.name: no-agent-runtime-internal-cross-import
forbidden.comment: SRP/ISP boundary (issue #137): agent-runtime's lifecycle/audit internals are reached only through its published port (src/index.ts) — never a caller reaching past it into lifecycleAdapter.ts, delegationRegistry.ts, sempConversation.ts, etc. directly.

forbidden.name: no-agent-runtime-provider-internals
forbidden.comment: DIP boundary (issue #137): agent-runtime depends only on the CreateAgentSession/AgentSession/CompactionAdapter/PiProviderRegistry ports it declares itself, never on the pinned pi-agent-core packages or a model provider's own package directly. src/__tests__/ is exempt: issue #134's piRuntimeContract.unit.test.ts is the one sanctioned direct import, pinning the exact shape those ports are written against.

forbidden.name: no-agent-runtime-guidance-database-import
forbidden.comment: Issue #214: the project-agent-guidance systemPromptOverride adapter receives an injected loadProjectAgentGuidance port and must never import pg, a pool singleton, or @semprec/data's concrete store directly.

forbidden.name: no-application-into-services-or-agent-runtime
forbidden.comment: Issue #214: packages/application/src/projectAgentGuidance is a neutral application service — it may depend on packages/shared's generic ports, never on services/* (its composition-root consumers) or packages/agent-runtime (a different consumer).
